visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brightly lit indoor exhibition space is shown. In the center, a large blue and white promotional backdrop stands on a blue carpeted platform. Various skincare products are displayed on nearby shelves under bright studio-style lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a hand holding two foil pouches of facial masks, one yellow and one blue, against a blurred background of a retail store shelf. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the glossy texture of the packaging. (3) A close-up view focuses on hands pulling a thin, translucent white fiber mask from a plastic container. The mask appears saturated with clear liquid. A woman with clear skin is seen in the background from the head and shoulders up. (4) The woman applies the white mask to her face in a bathroom-like setting with soft indoor lighting. She demonstrates the elasticity of the fabric by pulling at the cheek sections towards her ears, using her fingertips to smooth the edges around her nose and eyes. (5) A pink plastic pump bottle is featured. A person dispenses a clear, viscous liquid onto their palm and rubs it onto their face over makeup, demonstrating a cleansing action. The background shows white tiled walls. (6) A white bottle of skincare essence is presented. The creator applies a drop of clear gel to her forehead and spreads it using circular motions with her fingers. A small mirror is visible in front of her. (7) A small yellow and white squeeze bottle is held up. A white cream is squeezed onto the back of a hand and then applied to the woman's face, leaving a slight dewy finish. (8) A yellow package of nose strips is shown. The woman applies a small white rectangular strip specifically to the bridge and wings of her nose while looking into the camera. (9) A final graphic screen appears with pink and white branding, featuring social media icons for Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube against a clean white background.

By combining first-person demonstrations of the products' textures and application methods with energetic narration and vibrant on-screen text, the creator builds excitement and provides a quick 'must-buy' guide for beauty enthusiasts.
